verdict.rationale: Stripe ships multiple official CLIs relevant to agentic commerce: the Link CLI (npm @stripe/link-cli) giving agents wallet access and payment credentials, the mppx conformance CLI for machine payments, and the general Stripe CLI with sandbox provisioning explicitly aimed at coding agents. These are documented first-party with concrete install/usage instructions and even agent-legible docs (--llms-full). missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the CLI's reliability and a single unified 'agentic commerce CLI' rather than several separate tools.
